visual.description: Warm amber/yellow background used in the hero section and as a recurring brand color throughout the page.
Near-black used for all major headings and primary body text.
Deep dark brown-black used for standard body copy and paragraph text.
Light grey used as the default page/section background in content areas.
Warm off-white/cream used as a surface color in the footer and select content areas.
Muted sandy gold used as a secondary warm surface in creator gallery and mid-page sections.
Vibrant orange used for primary CTA buttons, highlighted text accents, and the Send button.
Muted teal/blue used as an accent color for active state pills, section backgrounds, and brand imagery elements.
Soft lavender/purple used in FAQ answer panels, footer contact sections, and as a recurring brand accent.
Near-pure black used for the navigation bar background (transparent at top, dark on scroll) and dark content sections.
Warm cream used for navigation text and links in the dark nav bar state (after scroll).
Amber hero background visible beneath the nav overlay at top-of-page state — nav appears transparent over it.
Dark text used for logo and nav links when nav is in transparent/top-of-page state over the amber hero.
Orange used as a link accent color in the footer Spotify section and for inline text links.
Orange border used on form field focus states and structural dividers in contact section.
Warm muted tan used for placeholder text in form inputs and de-emphasized content labels.
